https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi

WinFsp 2.1 (stable). Download the MSI above and save it next to this file as winfsp.msi;
the installer bundles it and the build scripts expect that name. The file is gitignored.

Keep this in lockstep with the winfsp.net package version in
src/WasabiDrive.WinFsp/WasabiDrive.WinFsp.csproj. The managed binding refuses to load against a
driver with a different major.minor -- winfsp.net 2.2 against a 2.1 driver fails at type-init with
"incorrect dll version (need 2.2, have 2.1)" -- so the bundled MSI and the package are one
decision, not two. 2.2 exists only as a beta (v2.2B1..B4), so stable 2.1 is the pinned pair:

    winfsp.net 2.1.25156  <->  winfsp-2.1.25156.msi
